contract.semantics: Synchronous monotone signed evidence. Explicit negatives require evidence; absent is unknown. Contradictions do not imply arbitrary atoms. Rule fires only when all signed premises supported and current round >= not_before. Earliest query evidence round is part of the scored answer.

prompt.edit_contract: All9 literal finite positions [-9,9], nonzero numerical mutation from supplied base. No files/tools/network/reporting. When crossover supplied retain at least one numerically distinguishing inherited scalar unchanged from EACH parent. Remaining params are authored mutation. Never invent gains.
